independence_statement_zh: 未读取 round1 或 round2 结论；逐篇阅读 7 篇原始摘要，对 5 篇方法/评测/理论边界读取官方 arXiv 相关正文。身份与原始日期使用 parent 提供的后验官方 Atom 原始响应，非其他轮审核结论。
criterion_zh: Harness 需要反馈驱动地修改外部可复用程序工件并保留复用；评测/理论须专项研究该演化。一般代理能力、安全评测、固定提示实验、训练权重和任务中的反复修正不能据词面纳入。
key_findings_zh: 7 篇均是今天发现的 10/29 HF 榜补充，不是 10/30 榜；保留各自经 arXiv 验证的原始日期。
LongZero 把训练后再生并重筛训练集列为 future work；当前结果不能按已完成多轮 RSI 处理。
DeepSeek 安全报告确有冻结 Rust 工作流后留出评测的 Harness 相关子任务；整篇仍是综合安全评测，不据此改成 Harness 专项。
TauIndianBankBench 的 arXiv 发布时间为 9/30，与 2610 编号月份不一致。只报告来源异常，不修改日期。
未声称读完所有论文或完成实验审计；5 篇是定向章节阅读，另 2 篇只作摘要范围判断。

abstract_quotes: We study how to amortize sequential Bayesian experimental design (BED) into an LLM by explicitly training the reasoning that guides action selection using information-gain rewards.

entries.improved_object_zh: 固定自合成数据后的 GRPO 权重训练
abstract_quotes: LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO.

fulltext_quotes.quote: Because the same model generates and filters the data, the difficulty of the kept questions adapts to the model that will be trained on them.
All methods, including the baselines, share this configuration, and we report the final checkpoint of each run;
Future work includes iterating LongZero so that the trained model regenerates and refilters its own data,

entries.boundary_zh: self-written、zero data 和 multi-round retrieval 是数据生成/任务形式。多步 GRPO 不等于多轮再生成训练数据。此处依据正文澄清单轮训练边界，建议排除当前 RSI 收录。

entries.title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks

abstract_source.abstract_source: original HF paper.summary; not HF AI summary
abstract_source.original_date_source: unknown; HF date is retained separately and not treated as original date

entries.improved_object_zh: 综合模型安全评测，包含有界研发任务
abstract_quotes: Drawing on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, we evaluate the model across 34 benchmarks, including 5 in-house suites, spanning evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation.

fulltext_quotes.quote: This report evaluates DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for such risks in three areas: evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation.
In the Rust workflow task, the agent builds an iterative scaffold that generates candidate Rust solutions, compiles them, and uses test feedback to repair errors;
we then freeze the submitted workflow and evaluate its pass rate on 165 held-out problems.

entries.rationale_zh: 主问题是综合模型失控、操纵及评测可信度。正文确有 RE-Bench Rust 子任务：产生一个可复用代码生成工作流并冻结后在留出题测试；这一实际 Harness 相关实验应保留说明，但不足以把整篇综合安全报告列为 Harness 演化专项方法或评测。
entries.boundary_zh: 不能笼统说它完全没有 Harness 相关内容。Rust 子实验与其余 AI 研发/安全任务分别记录；当前仍为 safety_governance/evaluation_benchmark，不自动加 secondary harness，不发布到 Harness 主专题。
